clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: Argus shall perform a SOC 2 Type II readiness assessment and produce a written report.

clauses.title: Limitation of Liability
clauses.text: Each party's aggregate liability shall not exceed the fees paid in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim, except for breaches of confidentiality or indemnification obligations.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: Argus shall maintain Customer's Confidential Information in strict confidence, with obligations surviving termination for five (5) years.

clauses.title: Termination
clauses.text: Either party may terminate this Agreement upon thirty (30) days written notice. Customer shall pay for services performed through the effective date of termination.
